architecture.description: what stands: the structure a system has, rather than one being proposed

design.description: a change being proposed; what it is, is written in the doc beside it. `proposed` and `decided` carry its lifecycle

design_new.title: Propose a design
design_new.description: Write a proposed change down as a stored record with named field groups: design{}, doc{title, body} and proposed{}. Who proposed it and when are stamped from the caller, never passed as arguments. Returns the applied changes as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and the components (named groups of fields) written or removed.

title.description: what the design proposes, in one line

project.description: the project to file it under; pass its id or registered name

design_decide.title: Decide a design
design_decide.description: Record the decision on a proposed design: approved or declined. The decider is the caller, stamped from the caller’s identity, so a decision an agent makes is recorded as the agent’s, and as an owner’s only when the owner is calling. Returns the applied changes as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and the components (named groups of fields) written or removed.

design.description: id or registered name of the design proposal to decide

verdict.description: decision to record: approved (default) or declined
approved, rejected, or approved once these changes are made

review.description: one person's assessment of a design: the verdict, and the comment beside it
